title: Can Claude replace QuotaPath? 24/24 checks, 10 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a QuotaPath alternative, a commission calculator with marginal tiers and statements, from one written spec: all 24 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 10 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:45): https://youtu.be/ryupZOqZHxg
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/commission-calculator
QuotaPath pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/quotapath

QuotaPath Growth is $35 per user per month plus a monthly platform fee, billed annually (quotapath.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
